svg.title: Athena process model
svg.desc: The React renderer runs sandboxed and reaches the network only through the preload allow-list and the Electron main process, which owns the token, the answer queue, the heartbeat, screenshot capture and the upload queue. Main calls the Express 5 backend over HTTP; the backend runs a fixed middleware order, keeps its rules in lib/ and stores data in JSON files and a screenshots folder.
svg.text: Athena: process model and the path of an answer
The page has no network access. Every request leaves through the main process, which also keeps answers and screenshots safe on disk first.
